comment: Every file in this repository that states the package version and that scripts/release.mjs and scripts/release-gate.mjs would not otherwise know about. Both scripts read this list: the release sets each one, the gate fails when one disagrees with package.json. `pattern` is a regular expression (multiline) whose first capture group is the version. package.json, package-lock.json, CITATION.cff, .claude-plugin/plugin.json and the README `uses:` pin are handled by the scripts themselves.
